title: Emotional Intelligence for Arts Administrators: Managing Social Relationships and Responsibilities
description: Emotional intelligence (EI) is arguably the most important key to success in one’s career and personal life. This course continues the exploration of research and theories of EI, the various dimensions of EI, and EIs applications in the arts. Students will examine their own EI through a variety of self-assessment tools, activities, and exercises. Students in this course will focus on their development of social skills as well as social relationship management and social responsibility.
prerequisites: Major status in Arts Administration and completion of all 100- and 200-level AAD courses and AAD 303
